title: Post-Cambrian geological record along the Transantarctic Mountains
note: Observations, not model output: rock units and their published ages and settings, for the Phanerozoic page (with the Cambrian items of cambrian_antarctica.json). Each place is the area-weighted centre of the unit's SCAR GeoMAP v2022-08 polygons in the area named (Cox et al. 2023), rounded; it is carried to the past with the plate under it, which is the model's part. Ages: as cited; where a source gives only a period, the ICS chart v2023/09 bounds. Compiled 2026-11-13.

where.en: Southern Victoria Land, Dry Valleys area

what.ko: 데본기 석영질 사암. 로스 조산대의 기반암을 깎은 평탄한 침식면(쿠크리 침식면) 위에 쌓였다. 하천과 얕은 바닷가 환경의 퇴적물이다. 융기·삭박 뒤 그 자리에 다시 쌓인 지층이다.
what.en: Devonian quartz sandstones laid on a flat erosion surface (the Kukri surface) cut across the Ross orogen's basement: river and shallow coastal deposits, laid down where the orogen had been uplifted and worn away.

refs: Elliot, D. H., 2013. The geological and tectonic evolution of the Transantarctic Mountains: a review. Geological Society, London, Special Publications, 381, 7–35.
Cox, S. C., et al., 2023. The GeoMAP (v.2022-08) continent-wide detailed geological dataset of Antarctica. PANGAEA, doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.951482 (age range of the unit).

where.en: Central Transantarctic Mountains, Beardmore Glacier area

what.ko: 후기 고생대 곤드와나 빙하기의 빙성 다이아믹타이트. 곤드와나가 남극 가까이 있던 때 대륙빙하가 이 지역을 덮었다. 나이는 페름기 초로 보며, 여기 범위(아셀절–사크마르절)는 대략이다.
what.en: Glacial diamictite of the late Palaeozoic Gondwana glaciation, when ice sheets covered the area as Gondwana lay near the South Pole. It is taken as earliest Permian; the span here (Asselian–Sakmarian) is approximate.

refs: Elliot, D. H., 2013. The geological and tectonic evolution of the Transantarctic Mountains: a review. Geological Society, London, Special Publications, 381, 7–35.
Cox, S. C., et al., 2023. GeoMAP v2022-08, doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.951482 (Permian age of the unit).

where.en: Central Transantarctic Mountains, Beardmore Glacier area

what.ko: 빙하가 물러간 뒤의 페름기 하천·늪 퇴적층. 석탄층과 글로소프테리스 식물 화석이 있다. 곤드와나 여러 대륙에 같은 식물상이 나온다.
what.en: Permian river and swamp deposits after the ice retreated, with coal seams and Glossopteris plant fossils, the flora shared across the Gondwana continents.

refs: Elliot, D. H., 2013. Geological Society, London, Special Publications, 381, 7–35.
Cox, S. C., et al., 2023. GeoMAP v2022-08, doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.951482 (Permian age of the unit).

where.ko: 중부 남극종단산맥, 비어드모어 빙하 일대 (화석은 콜색 블러프)
where.en: Central Transantarctic Mountains, Beardmore Glacier area (the fossils: Coalsack Bluff)

what.ko: 트라이아스기 전기–중기의 하천 퇴적층. 1969–70년에 리스트로사우루스 등 네발 척추동물 화석이 나왔다. 남아프리카·인도와 같은 동물상이라 곤드와나가 한 덩어리였다는 증거가 되었다.
what.en: Early to Middle Triassic river deposits that yielded tetrapods, Lystrosaurus among them, in 1969–70: the same fauna as in southern Africa and India, and evidence that Gondwana had been one landmass.

refs: Elliot, D. H., Colbert, E. H., Breed, W. J., Jensen, J. A., and Powell, J. S., 1970. Triassic tetrapods from Antarctica: evidence for continental drift. Science, 169, 1197–1201.
Cox, S. C., et al., 2023. GeoMAP v2022-08, doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.951482.

name.en: Ferrar large igneous province (Kirkpatrick Basalt, Ferrar Dolerite)

where.ko: 남극종단산맥 전체 (용암은 비어드모어 빙하 일대의 커크패트릭 현무암)
where.en: The whole Transantarctic Mountains (the lavas: Kirkpatrick Basalt, Beardmore Glacier area)

what.ko: 쥐라기 전기의 짧은 화성 활동. 조립현무암 암상이 비컨 누층군 사이로 들어가고 그 위를 현무암 용암이 덮었다. 곤드와나가 갈라지기 시작할 때의 일이며, 연대는 약 40만 년 안에 몰려 있다.
what.en: A brief Early Jurassic magmatic event: dolerite sills intruded the Beacon Supergroup and basalt lavas covered it, as Gondwana began to break apart; the dates fall within about 0.4 Myr.

refs: Burgess, S. D., Bowring, S. A., Fleming, T. H., and Elliot, D. H., 2015. High-precision geochronology links the Ferrar large igneous province with early-Jurassic ocean anoxia and biotic crisis. Earth and Planetary Science Letters, 415, 90–99.

what.ko: 인회석 피션 트랙 냉각 나이로 본 빠른 융기와 삭박. 약 55 Ma에 시작했고, 로스해 쪽 열개의 어깨로 솟았다. 지금의 산맥은 이때 생겼다.
what.en: Rapid uplift and erosion read from apatite fission-track cooling ages, starting about 55 Ma, as the shoulder of the Ross Sea rift: today's range dates from this.

refs: Fitzgerald, P. G., 1992. The Transantarctic Mountains of southern Victoria Land: the application of apatite fission track analysis to a rift shoulder uplift. Tectonics, 11, 634–662.

where.ko: 중부 남극종단산맥, 비어드모어 빙하 상류 (도미니언 산맥 등)
where.en: Central Transantarctic Mountains, upper Beardmore Glacier (Dominion Range and others)

what.ko: 높은 곳에 남은 신생대 빙하 퇴적물. 나이는 논쟁 중이다(플라이오세라는 설과 더 오래되었다는 설). 여기 범위는 GeoMAP이 단위에 준 것이다.
what.en: Cenozoic glacial deposits left high in the range. Their age is debated (Pliocene, or older); the span here is the one GeoMAP gives the unit.

refs: Webb, P.-N., Harwood, D. M., McKelvey, B. C., Mercer, J. H., and Stott, L. D., 1984. Cenozoic marine sedimentation and ice-volume variation on the East Antarctic craton. Geology, 12, 287–291.
Cox, S. C., et al., 2023. GeoMAP v2022-08, doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.951482 (age range of the unit).
